retry_policy: Retry only network/non-200 transient service errors. No retries for cached HTTP200 outputs, even if incorrect, truncated, or invalid. Transport failures retained.
model_identity: Require exact provider-reported model string. Not cryptographic backend attestation.

source_commit_identity.note: Not attributed to an unrelated current/historical git commit. Exact run-time sources frozen.

scope: Constructed symbolic fixed-record diagnostic using EnactToM entity vocabularies and StateStore. NOT simulator physics, original task execution, native camera visibility, visual compilation, original Habitat planner serialization or independent NL summarizer.
information_loss: no_links preserves all physical and social records but removes their join. no_attribution nulls holder/sender without swapping identities. Unknown can be the rational ablated answer; a score gap does not prove equal-information reasoning superiority.

engineering_cache_parent.reason: Semantic citation/location errors now affect their own metric only, not syntactic validity or all state scores. JSON/type/truncation failures unchanged.

public_redaction: Credential paths/locks, runtime source/output paths omitted; no key values were stored.
